name: Fantasy: Character Action Clip
description: Video preset for a character clip in the Fantasy look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second character clip. State the single action, the camera move, and the mood. Keep the character's design identical to the entity's description.
context_prompt: short clip of the character performing one clear action that shows personality, start and end pose readable, epic fantasy concept painting, painterly brushwork, ornate hand-crafted armour and cloth, ancient architecture with real scale, golden light through mist, rich jewel-tone palette, volumetric god rays, atmospheric depth, sweeping aerial and crane moves, cloaks and banners in wind, drifting embers and motes of light
negative_prompt: modern clothing, guns, cars, sci-fi technology, photographic snapshot look, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
